_how_to: One hunt per entry. id: MUST match a key under comps.comps in comps.json or the watch can never card (no real comps = no deal claim). query: what to search. city: FB Marketplace city slug. max_price: only alert at or below this (USD). category: electronics | furniture | instruments | vehicles | other. results_cap: max listings this watch may fetch per daily scan (shared 800/month Apify budget).
_budget_note: 3 watches x 8 results = 24/day ~= 720/month, under the 800 cap. Raise deliberately, not by accident.
